description: This file defines an Angular component named 'Row' used for layout purposes, specifically for rendering a flexible row with alignment and distribution options. It extends a DynamicComponent and uses Angular features such as decorators, dependency injection, and template syntax.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: Angular component class that renders a flexible row layout with customizable alignment and distribution.

methods.name: alignment
methods.description: Input property that determines the vertical alignment of the row; defaults to 'stretch'.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Input property that determines the horizontal distribution of the row content; defaults to 'start'.

methods.name: classes
methods.description: Computed property that returns an object with CSS classes based on alignment and distribution settings.
